title: 🤖 November Pixel Update Brings Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10!
body: 🤖 November Pixel Update Brings Gemini Intelligence to Pixel 10!

Google announced the November 2026 “Pixel Drop” update, bringing AI features, customization options, and connectivity improvements to Pixel phones. The highlight is “Gemini intelligence” arriving on Pixel 10 phones, along with new home-screen tools and improvements to the call screening feature. Sales of the new “Pixel Tag” tracking device also began in the United States.
Simply put: Pixel’s regular updates add new features to your phone without buying a new device; this time, Gemini intelligence reaches Pixel 10 phones directly.
Do you use AI features on your phone every day?
